TranslationContext: This file contains Unit Names for the Greenskin Tribes Faction.

Translations.Comment: 緑皮 = greenskin, 部族 = tribe. Conveys brutal, tribal fantasy wargame tone.
オーク = orc, 戦士 = warrior. Keeps brutal and direct feeling.
蛮族 = brutes/savages. Conveys thuggish brutality of orc soldiers.
暴動団 = mob/riotous group. Conveys chaotic horde-like nature.
槍 = spear. Goblin horde with spears in chaotic formations.
イノシシ = wild boar, 騎手 = rider. Savage greenskin cavalry.
狼 = wolf, 騎手 = rider. Swift wolf-riding goblin cavalry.
猪 = boar, 戦車 = war chariot. Epic and warlike vehicle.
短弓兵 = shortbow archer. Lighter ranged goblin troops.
矢砲 = bolt thrower/arrow artillery. Mechanical siege weapons.
石投機 = stone thrower/catapult. Crude but effective siege weapon.
トロル = troll (katakana). Regenerating monsters of folklore.
巨人 = giant. Classic mythical creature of immense size.
ワイバーン = wyvern (katakana). Two-legged flying dragon.
巨大なる = giant, 蜘蛛 = spider. Monstrous arachnid creature.
司令官 = war chief/commander. Tribal military leader.
シャーマン = shaman. Tribal magic user with mystical powers.
王 = king. Grand title for greenskin faction leader.
